tools.name: get_space_note_tree
tools.title: Get a space note
tools.description: Retrieve the full notes tree for a space.

tools.name: get_note
tools.title: Get a note
tools.description: Get a single note by its ID.

language.description: Optional language/translation to read (e.g. 'fr', 'de'); omit for the note's default content. Use get_note_translations to list which languages exist.

tools.name: create_space_note
tools.title: Create a note in a space
tools.description: Create a new note inside a space under its root note

summary.description: Text only, no html no markdown summary of the note content

tools.name: create_child_note
tools.title: Create a note under another note
tools.description: Create a new note as a child of another note.

summary.description: Text only, no html no markdown summary of the note content

tools.name: update_note
tools.title: Update a note
tools.description: Update an existing note with new content or title.

tools.name: publish_note
tools.title: Publish a note
tools.description: Publish a note by its ID.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.title: Delete a note
tools.description: Delete a note by its ID.

tools.name: move_note
tools.title: Move a note
tools.description: Move a note under another parent note.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search for notes
tools.description: Search notes with query text and optional filters.

tools.name: get_note_versions
tools.title: Get a note's version history
tools.description: List the version history of a note: each version's number, id, title, content, date and author. Use restore_note_version to roll back to one.

language.description: Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.

tools.name: restore_note_version
tools.title: Restore a note version
tools.description: Restore a note to a previous version identified by its version_number (from get_note_versions). Creates a new current version from the chosen one.

version_number.description: The version_number to restore, from get_note_versions.

language.description: Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.

tools.name: set_note_cover
tools.title: Set a note's cover image
tools.description: Set a note's cover (featured) image from a public image URL or base64 bytes. The image is wired into the note so it actually renders as the note's illustration.

image_url.description: Direct http(s) URL of an image to use as the cover. Provide exactly one image source.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (png, jpeg, gif or webp), optionally as a data: URI. Provide exactly one image source.

attachment_object_type.description: Internal: object type of an existing platform attachment to use as the cover (set automatically by the client from the user's attached image — do not fill this yourself). Read as the current user, so its ACL is enforced.

attachment_object_id.description: Internal: object id of an existing platform attachment to use as the cover (set automatically by the client — do not fill this yourself). Provide exactly one image source: attachment_object_id, image_url or image_base64.

alt_text.description: Optional accessibility description of the cover image.

language.description: Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.
Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.

tools.name: set_note_summary
tools.title: Set a note's summary
tools.description: Set (or replace) a note's summary — the short excerpt shown on note cards and previews. The note's cover image is preserved.

summary.description: The summary text to set. Pass an empty string to clear it.

language.description: Optional note language/translation to target (e.g. 'en', 'fr'); omit for the default note.

tools.name: get_note_translations
tools.title: List a note's translations
tools.description: List the language codes a note has translations for (e.g. ['en','fr']). An empty list means the note has only its default content. Use get_note with a 'language' to read a specific translation, and update_note with a 'language' to create/update one.
